title: Investigating the novel-binding site of RPA2 on Menin and predicting the effect of point mutation of Menin through protein-protein interactions.
authors: Kaur, Gurjeet; Prajapat, Manisha; Singh, Harvinder; Sarma, Phulen; Bhadada, Sanjay Kumar; Shekhar, Nishant; Sharma, Saurabh; Sinha, Shweta; Kumar, Subodh; Prakash, Ajay; Medhi, Bikash
one_liner_zh: 该文用同源建模、对接和MD/MM-PBSA研究Menin与RPA2蛋白-蛋白互作及点突变效应，虽涉及转录因子相关蛋白但核心是PPI而非TF-DNA结合，方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA界面建模。
abstract: Protein-protein interactions (PPIs) play a critical role in all biological processes. Menin is tumor suppressor protein, mutated in multiple endocrine neoplasia type 1 syndrome and has been shown to interact with multiple transcription factors including (RPA2) subunit of replication protein A (RPA). RPA2, heterotrimeric protein required for DNA repair, recombination and replication. However, it's still remains unclear the specific amino acid residues that have been involved in Menin-RPA2 interaction. Thus, accurately predicting the specific amino acid involved in interaction and effects of MEN1 mutations on biological systems is of great interests. The experimental approaches for identifying amino acids in menin-RPA2 interactions are expensive, time-consuming, and challenging. This study leverages computational tools, free energy decomposition and configurational entropy scheme to annotate the menin-RPA2 interaction and effect on menin point mutation, thereby proposing a viable model of menin-RPA2 interaction. The menin-RPA2 interaction pattern was calculated on the basis of different 3D structures of menin and RPA2 complexes, constructed using homology modeling and docking strategy, generating three best-fit models: Model 8 (- 74.89 kJ/mol), Model 28 (- 92.04 kJ/mol) and Model 9 (- 100.4 kJ/mol). The molecular dynamic (MD) was performed for 200 ns and binding free energies and energy decomposition analysis were calculated using Molecular Mechanics Poisson-Boltzmann Surface Area (MM/PBSA) in GROMACS. From binding free energy change, model 8 of Menin-RPA2 exhibited most negative binding energy of - 205.624 kJ/mol, followed by model 28 of Menin-RPA2 with - 177.382 kJ/mol. After S606F point mutation in Menin, increase of BFE (DeltaG(bind)) by - 34.09 kJ/mol in Model 8 of mutant Menin-RPA2 occurs. Interestingly, we found a significant reduction of BFE (DeltaG(bind)) and configurational entropy by - 97.54 kJ/mol and - 2618 kJ/mol in mutant model 28 as compared the o wild type. Collectively, this is the first study to highlight the configurational entropy of protein-protein interactions thereby strengthening the prediction of two significant important interaction sites in menin for the binding of RPA2. These predicted sites could be vulnerable for structural alternation in terms of binding free energy and configurational entropy after missense mutation in menin.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）在所有生物过程中发挥关键作用。Menin是一种肿瘤抑制蛋白，在多发性内分泌腺瘤1型综合征中发生突变，并已被证明与多种转录因子相互作用，包括复制蛋白A（RPA）的RPA2亚基。RPA2是一种异三聚体蛋白，参与DNA修复、重组和复制。然而，参与Menin-RPA2相互作用的具体氨基酸残基仍不清楚。因此，准确预测参与相互作用的特定氨基酸以及MEN1突变对生物系统的影响具有重要意义。用于识别menin-RPA2相互作用中氨基酸的实验方法成本高昂、耗时且具有挑战性。本研究利用计算工具、自由能分解和构象熵方案来注释menin-RPA2相互作用及其对menin点突变的影响，从而提出一个可行的menin-RPA2相互作用模型。基于使用同源建模和对接策略构建的menin和RPA2复合物的不同3D结构，计算了menin-RPA2相互作用模式，生成了三个最佳拟合模型：模型8（-74.89 kJ/mol）、模型28（-92.04 kJ/mol）和模型9（-100.4 kJ/mol）。进行了200 ns的分子动力学（MD）模拟，并使用GROMACS中的分子力学泊松-玻尔兹曼表面积（MM/PBSA）方法计算了结合自由能和能量分解分析。从结合自由能变化来看，Menin-RPA2的模型8表现出最负的结合能-205.624 kJ/mol，其次是Menin-RPA2的模型28，为-177.382 kJ/mol。在Menin中S606F点突变后，突变型Menin-RPA2模型8的结合自由能（DeltaG(bind)）增加了-34.09 kJ/mol。有趣的是，与野生型相比，突变型模型28中结合自由能（DeltaG(bind)）和构象熵显著降低，分别为-97.54 kJ/mol和-2618 kJ/mol。总体而言，这是第一项强调蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用构象熵的研究，从而加强了对menin中两个重要相互作用位点用于RPA2结合的预测。这些预测位点在menin错义突变后，可能在结合自由能和构象熵方面易受结构改变的影响。
